faq.a: Marwani is associated with the Arabic form مرواني, whose core sense is marwani; of marwan, belonging to marwan.

faq.q: What is the origin of Marwani?
faq.a: Marwani is associated with Arabic. Marwani is Arabic مَرْوَانِيّ (Marwāniyy), the nisba of مَرْوَان (Marwān), meaning 'of Marwan; belonging to Marwan'. The source gloss 'From Marwan' is consistent.
Yes — the underlying form مرواني is Arabic.

faq.a: In Urdu, Marwani is rendered مروانی and carries the sense مروانی، مروان سے منسوب.

faq.q: What does Marwani mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Marwani is rendered مروانی and carries the sense مروانی، منسوب به مروان.
A romanized syllable approximation is mar-wa-ni. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Marwani?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Marwani, marwani. Script forms are مرواني, مروانی, मरवानी.

faq.q: Is Marwani a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
